claim: Fable-5 LLM Council model fallback priority: Tier 1 = Ollama qwen3.5:9b-nvfp4 (local, always first), Tier 2 = SKIP Windows GPU (offline), Tier 3 = GLM-5.2 BigModel (fallback), Tier 4 = Sonnet 5 Medium (absolute last resort only). Timeout: 10s per tier. No further fallback after Sonnet fails.

decisions.notes: Session 2026-07-04 Fable-5 LLM council processing requires clear model priority. Local Ollama must be tried first (lowest latency, highest throughput). Windows GPU is currently offline — skip it entirely to save fallback time. GLM-5.2 is reliable regional option. Sonnet 5 is expensive cloud option — use only when all else fails. This priority ensures cost-effective, fast-first operation.
